paite: Huan Solomon in TOUPA min a ding inn leh kumpipa inn ding toh lam atum hi.
heading: Tempul Lam Ding A Kisakkholhna / (1 Kum 5.1-18)

paite: Solomon in van po ding mi singsagih leh mual a singphukmi singgiat leh amau vengmi sangthum-le-zaguk asep hi.
Solomon in Tura kumpipa Huram kiang ah, "Ka pa David thil na hihsak a, a-omna inn lamna ding sidarte na khak bang in, kei leng hon kithuahpih sam in.

Ngai dih, TOUPA ka Pathian min a-inn amah a dia lam a, ama a gimlim hal a, tanghou siah koih gige a, Sabbathte, kha thakte, TOUPA ka Pathian ankuanglui nite a zingsang leh nitak a halmang thillat latna ding inn ka lam ding ahi. Hiaite Israelte a ding in tangtawn thupiak ahi.
Huchi in ka inn lam tup athupi mahmah ding ahi; pathian tengteng sang a ka Pathian uh thupizaw ahih ziak in.
Van, vante van ah leng ta lou ahi ngal a, kua'n ahia a-inn lamsak thei ding? Kei, ama a gimlim halna ding lel chih louh ngal kei leltak in ka lamsak thei mahmah dia hia?

Huchi in Judah gam leh Jerusalem a mikhutsiamte ka pa David in ana zatsek, tu in ka kiang a omte lak a sem ding in mi khat, dangka-eng, dangkasik, dal, sik lam khoih thei, puan sandup, san-au, dumpuang bawl siam, gelh bangchibang peuh siam mi hon sawl in.
Lebanon a sidar sing, meilah sing, algum sing leng hon khak lechin; na mite'n Lebanon a singphuk asiam mahmah uh chih ka thei ngal a; huchi in ngai dih, ka mite nang mite lak ah tel sam le uh,
sing tampi hon ngaihtuahsak ding: ka inn lam tup athupi mahmah ding ahi.
Ngai dih, na singphuk mite huit buh pota a singnih leh barli buh pota singnih leh uain bath singnih leh thau bath singnih ka pe ding," chi in mi asawl hi.
Huchi in Tura kumpipa Huram in, "TOUPA'N amite a-it ziak in akumpipa ding ua nang hon bawl ei ve," chi in lai khak in Solomon adawng hi.
Huram in, "TOUPA, Israel' Pathian, lei leh van bawlpa, TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn lam ding a pilna leh theihna nei tapa piltak kumpipa David pepa phat in om hen.
Mikhutsiam, theihtheihna nei, ka pa Huram amah mah, ka hon sawl a,

Dan suan a mi numei khat tapa ngei, apa bel Tura a mi, dangka-eng lam, dangkasik lam, dal lam, sik lam, suang lam, sing lam, puan sandup, dumpuang, puanmalngat, sandang khoihsa, gelh bangchibang leng siam, siam chiteng siam ahi a; nang mikhutsiamte leh ka pu, na pa David khutsiamte lak ah ahong sem ding uhi.
Huchi in huit buh, barli buh, thau, uain thu ka toupa'n agen asikhate hon khak hen.
Huchi in kou Lebanon a sing na deih zahzah ka na phuk ding ua, tuipi ah Jopa tan in ka hon tolhsak ding uh; huan, nang Jerusalem ah na nawntou ding hi," achi hi.
Huan Solomon in Israel gam a apa David in asimsa, namdangmi tengteng asim a, nuaikhat singnga sangthum-le-zaguk ahi uh.
Huchi in van po ding mi singsagih leh tang a singphukmi singgiat leh mipite sepdan ngaihtuahsak ding mi sangthum-le-zaguk asep hi.
